So for [InventoryList.tsx](src/pages/Facility/services/inventory/InventoryList.tsx#L118), the project-consistent pattern would be:

```tsx
<TabsContent value="incoming">{renderDeliveries()}</TabsContent>
<TabsContent value="outgoing">{renderDeliveries()}</TabsContent>
```

The current dynamic `TabsContent value={direction}` is functionally valid and avoids duplication, but explicit panels with a shared render function are clearer and align better with the rest of the codebase.
